newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian commercial bank assets rise in October.
newsitem.headline: Estonian commercial bank assets rise in October.

text.p: The assets of Estonian banks rose to 20.03 billion kroons in October from 19.62 billion kroons the previous month, the central bank said on Friday.
Leading bank Hansapank showed the largest assets at 4.981 billion kroons, slightly down from September's 4.983 billion kroons, the central bank said in a statement.
The second largest was Savings Bank at 4.03 billion kroons, versus September's 4.05 billion kroons.
The central bank said that commercial banks' deposits rose to 13.20 billion kroons in October from September's 12.70 billion kroons.
The central bank also said that the most active over-night term of the interbank market showed trade of 2.38 billion kroons in October, higher than September's 2.10 billion kroons.
The overnight weighted average interest rate in October was lower at 2.95 percent versus the previous month's 3.35 percent, the central bank added.
